id: title:Radu-Raicea:add short scorer names and refine scorer management

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a `short_name` field to score definitions and the associated API, allowing users to specify a compact label alongside the full name for display and potentially search, while retaining the full name. This supports UI display improvements and potentially reduces truncation or improves readability in score-related views.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement: adding a new optional `short_name` field to score definitions and its API, including creation, update, and versioning, with a 40-char max and optional status. This allows the backend API to return a compact label for score definitions, supporting UI display of shorter names. The implementation and relevant checks
